Alex — thanks for sending. High level thoughts below; I'll pull copy suggestions into a doc and share by EOD. Quick summary first: 

SMB bundle (recommended):
- "Start" tier: pay-as-you-go (usage-first) with low setup; called out as "No minimum commit, ideal for pilots"
- Clear callout: API + SDKs included, 10k free tokens first 30 days

Enterprise bundle (recommended):
- "Scale" tier: named-seat + reserved throughput with volume discounts; includes dedicated support and SOC2 evidence pack
- Callout: enterprise SLA, private VPC option, optional dedicated capacity

On pricing framing: AWS listing copy that highlights immediate time-to-value (pilot-ready) + a simple pricing snapshot tends to increase demo requests. If you can show a usage example (tokens -> $) in the bullets, that reduces questions in procurement.

Action items: 
- Marissa: can you draft short 1-liners for the two bundles we can use on the hero and feature bullets?
- Ben: can you validate the pricing-sheet columns that map to AMI/region availability? (see attached image I uploaded below).

I'll attach a suggested hero line and three feature bullets in the next message.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
